name: Sri. M Natarajan
biography: Sri. M Natarajan is the visionary Founder Chairman of Valia Koonambaikulathamma College of Engineering and Technology. With a deep commitment to quality education and the development of technical manpower in Kerala, he established VKCET with the mission of providing world-class engineering education to students from all walks of life.

Under his leadership, VKCET has grown into a premier institution affiliated to APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University and approved by AICTE, offering undergraduate programs in multiple engineering disciplines. His vision continues to inspire the college's pursuit of academic excellence, holistic development, and community service.
